assumptions.note: Synthetic workload model; no live provider/network measurement and no contractual data-rights approval.

topFindings: CCXT-based combinations form the highest simulated CADS band under the declared assumptions.
Cryptofeed is modeled as the lowest-latency WebSocket-specialist path but with lower portability than CCXT.
OpenBB is modeled for breadth/multi-asset normalization rather than low-latency tick ingestion.
DefiLlama is modeled as REST fundamentals/DeFi enrichment, not a venue tick feed.
yfinance remains RESEARCH_ONLY because software license and Yahoo data-use rights are separate.
